review_note: Vital-sign danger ranges and escalation thresholds for adult obstetric patients. Shock-index values are guideline/literature-derived and verified (see citation_ids). MEOWS/IMEWS-style band tables are included as a CONFIGURABLE starting parameter set — the primary IMEWS/NCEC chart could not be retrieved during authoring; those band values are marked verification_status='requires_clinical_review' and must be confirmed against the national chart in use at deployment sites before pilot.

scope.out_of_scope: Neonatal and pediatric vital-sign ranges (future Pediatric Emergency module; do not reuse these ranges for children)

input_validation.on_reject: Do not compute. Return missing-information flag; never estimate or impute vitals.

bands.meaning: No shock-index alert. Does not exclude hemorrhage; interpret with blood loss and symptoms.
Warning: hemodynamic alert. In community/PHC settings, treat as trigger for urgent escalation and transfer preparation. Associated with increased mortality risk.
Critical: hemorrhagic shock until proven otherwise. High likelihood of transfusion requirement and need for advanced intervention. Immediate escalation and referral.

shock_index.config_note: Thresholds are policy-configurable but may never be set LESS sensitive than the FIGO 0.9 alert (e.g., a policy may add an intermediate band at 1.1 but may not raise the warning threshold above 0.9).

vital_sign_danger_ranges.note: Red ranges demand immediate clinician attention and pathway escalation when combined with bleeding. Amber ranges trigger enhanced monitoring. These are obstetric-specific (pregnancy physiology blunts early changes).

parameters.red_high_note: Red-high BP indicates possible severe hypertensive disorder — triggers severe preeclampsia pathway evaluation AND hard-blocks ergot alkaloids in PPH context.
parameters.verification_status: verified (low ranges: FIGO 2022 hypovolemia signs; high ranges: standard severe-range obstetric hypertension cutoffs — confirm against deployment-site chart)

parameters.red_high_note: DBP >= 110 = severe-range hypertension; same preeclampsia-pathway trigger and ergot-alkaloid block.
parameters.verification_status: verified (severe-range cutoffs standard across obstetric hypertension guidelines — confirm against deployment-site chart)

parameters.red_high_note: HR > 120 with bleeding is a hypovolemia red flag even if BP is preserved (pregnancy compensation). Always interpret with shock index.
parameters.verification_status: verified (HR > 120 cited as hypovolemia sign in FIGO 2022 / ACOG PB 183; amber bands require chart confirmation)

parameters.red_high_note: Tachypnea out of proportion may indicate shock, acidosis, sepsis, or pulmonary edema (e.g., fluid overload, magnesium context).
Fever postpartum raises sepsis concern (maternal sepsis module); hypothermia worsens coagulopathy in hemorrhage — active warming.
Oliguria < 0.5 mL/kg/h indicates inadequate perfusion; a resuscitation target and a sepsis/AKI warning sign.
parameters.verification_status: verified (resuscitation target consistent with FIGO 2022 section 11 / RCOG resuscitation guidance)

parameters.red_high_note: Altered mental status in PPH = end-organ hypoperfusion; escalates severity regardless of measured blood loss.
parameters.verification_status: verified (concept) / band mapping requires chart confirmation

blood_loss_bands.note: Volume bands interpret cumulative measured/estimated loss; physiologic bands (shock index) always override low volume estimates because visual estimation underestimates.

bands.action: severe PPH protocol: full first-response bundle, prepare refractory measures, anticipate transfusion and escalation
anticipate coagulopathy; massive transfusion capability and surgical escalation required

rule_of_30.text: Approximate 30% blood-volume loss markers (hemorrhage severity heuristic): fall of 30 mmHg systolic BP, rise of 30 beats/min pulse, fall of 30% hematocrit, fall of ~3 g/dL hemoglobin (~30%).

escalation_thresholds.trigger: shock_index >= 0.9 AND setting in [community, home_birth, phc_without_transfusion]
escalation_thresholds.action: urgent transfer alert to receiving facility; begin first-response measures concurrently

escalation_thresholds.trigger: shock_index >= 1.3 OR (systolic_bp_mmHg < 90 AND heart_rate_bpm > 120) OR mental_status in [pain_responsive, unresponsive] attributable to hypovolemia
escalation_thresholds.action: immediate transfer to surgical/transfusion-capable facility with NASG/compression temporizing measures and ongoing resuscitation en route

escalation_thresholds.trigger: bleeding continues 15-30 minutes after first-response bundle completed
escalation_thresholds.action: activate refractory-PPH bundle (bimanual/aortic compression, balloon tamponade, NASG, second TXA dose, continued uterotonic infusion); summon senior clinician

escalation_thresholds.trigger: required resource unavailable (uterotonics / blood / surgical capability) with ongoing PPH
escalation_thresholds.action: temporize and transfer; never delay transfer waiting for deterioration; document resource gap in referral note

escalation_thresholds.trigger: systolic_bp_mmHg >= 140 OR diastolic_bp_mmHg >= 90 OR documented hypertensive disorder, AND second-line uterotonic being considered
escalation_thresholds.action: hard-block ergometrine / oxytocin-ergometrine; offer misoprostol alternative; flag preeclampsia pathway evaluation

missing_information_policy.rule: The engine never imputes missing vitals, weights, times, or contraindication fields. Missing critical fields produce an explicit missing-information list and the fail-safe default: treat as higher acuity until data arrive, with drug recommendations gated per medications.v1.json contraindication rules.
